# PeerDAS Breakout Room - Call #27 | April 29, 2025 - [Apr 29 (Tues), 2025, 14:00 UTC](https://savvytime.com/converter/utc/apr-29-2025/2pm) - [Zoom link](https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/82343923303?pwd=aGLyX8xtcVeaDni8mhQi7NNIkzwuUT.1) ### Resources - [Ethereum Protocol Call calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y191cGFvZm9uZzhtZ3JtcmtlZ243aWM3aGs1c0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t) - [PeerDAS-PM.md](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/Breakout-Room-Meetings/PeerDAS/PeerDAS-pm.md) - [Google Doc Meeting Notes](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ng2IrCe28kTt1BnIsjtMlKHq2MHgaja24LhFXSvqfJQ/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.2za2utdyu31m) - [Previous call](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1491) - Facilitator email: [will@ethereum.org](mailto:will@ethereum.org) - Facilitator Telegram: @corcoranwill # Agenda Overview A. Client Updates B. Devnet / Testing Updates C. Spec / EIP Discussion D. Open Discussion # Agenda Details ## Client Updates ### CL Client Teams | Team | Active ICs | Previous Update | |------|------------|----------------| | [Lighthouse](https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aopen%20label%3Adas) | Jimmy, Pawan + J | - Fixing issue with clients not serving data columns from peers who were not synced | | [Prysm](https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/14129) | Manu, Terence & Radek + Francis & Niram from Base | - Merging chunks of PeerDAS branch into develop branch (KZG library and RPC structure)| | [Teku](https://github.com/Consensys/teku/issues/9274) | Dmitrii + Jerone Ost from Soneium | - Working on builder flow integration with local production complete | | [Nimbus](https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+fulu+) | Agnish & Dustin | - Working to improve column syncing | | [Lodestar](https://github.com/ChainSafe/lodestar/issues/7429) | Matt K, Katya + Derek & Hugh from Base | - Working on multiple PRs for DA pipeline refactor | | [Grandine](https://github.com/grandinetech/grandine/pull/55) | Hangleang & Saulius Grigaitis | - Diving back in after OOO | ### EL Client Teams | Team | Active ICs | Pervious Update | |------|------------|----------------| | [Geth](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pulls) | Felix, Marius, Lightclient | - No update provided | | [Nethermind](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/8417) | FLCL, Marcin | - Network encoding optimizations + investigating flat data structures vs. separate traces | | [Reth](https://github.com/paradigmxyz/reth/pull/15534) | Roman | - Testing Reth w/ other clients | | [Besu](https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pulls) | tbd | - No update provided | | [Erigon](https://github.com/erigontech/erigon/pulls) | tbd | - No update provided | | [ethereumjs](https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pulls) | Gajinder | - Getting ready to participate in devnet | ## Devnet / Testing Updates | Topic | Subtopic | Details | |-------|----------|---------| | **peerdas-devnet** | devnet-6 | - devnet-6 has been deprecated due to bugs requiring client fixes
- Testing is currently happening on Sunnyside Labs network with ~70 nodes running DevNet-6 spec. | | | devnet-7 | - Launch will be planned once fixes are implemented
- Kurtosis configs are available for local testing of fixes. | ## Spec / EIP Discussion | Topic | Subtopic | Details | |-------|----------|---------| | **BPO Schedule** | CL/EL BPO blob schedule | - CL: removal of BPO forks from current blob schedule
- EL: decisions made on blob schedule config structure / format? | ### Open Specs & Discussions - Consensus: Fulu BlobSidecarsByRange/Root Deprecation Support ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4286))[SunnysideJ] - Consensus: Remove placeholder MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_FULU ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/4266)) [Justin Traglia] - Consensus: Implement BPO fork blob limit logic ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/4267)) [Justin Traglia] - Engine API: Add EIP-7594 (PeerDAS) related change ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/630)) [Francis Li] - Builder: Add EIP-7594 (PeerDAS) related change ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/117)) [Francis Li] - [Francis] Beacon-API: [EIP-7594] Add new getBlobSidecars spec ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/524)) [Francis Li] - Update EIP-7594: Add blob count per tx limit via blobSchedule ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9623)) [FLCL] ### Draft Specs & Discussions - Update EIP-7594: Polish EIP, expand rationale ([link](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9588)) ## Open Discussion # Schedule | Date(s) | Item | |------|-----------| | April 9th | peerdas-devenet-6 live! | | May ~5th | Pectra Mainnet | | ~June 1st | fusaka-devnet-0 (w/ BPO) | | June 8-14 | EL / CL Interop | | Post June 14 | Audits: KZG libraries (c-kzg-4844, rust-eth-kzg, go-eth-kzg) |
